title: Nicole Young Reveals Status on Selling Sunset Amid Chrishell Feud
htmlContent:
Nicole Young, who stars on Netflix's Selling Sunset, recently revealed her status after stepping back from filming due to a messy feud with her co-star, Chrishell Stause. In a statement to Us Weekly, Nicole explained her absence and discussed the ongoing drama with Chrishell and the rest of the cast.

Nicole Young Addresses Her Status on Selling Sunset

On January 23, 2025, Nicole Young confirmed she was not fired from the Selling Sunset cast. Despite rumors about her exit from the show, Nicole remained a part of the cast, but production had decided to suspend her filming schedule. Nicole explained that the decision was made to prevent her from being harmed by escalating tensions on set. Nicole revealed, “I had a call with production two days ago during which they told me I have not been fired from the cast but they chose to pause my filming schedule until next week in order to protect me from situations on set that had become very contentious.” This statement clarified her position on the show, which was previously unclear due to ongoing drama with her co-stars, particularly Chrishell Stause, who has been vocal about their differences.

The Root of the Feud: Chrishell Stause vs. Nicole Young

Chrishell Stause and Nicole Young have been at odds for a long time. During Season 6 of Selling Sunset, Nicole accused Chrishell of receiving real estate listings due to a personal relationship with Jason Oppenheim, which led to their initial conflict.
The owner of the Oppenheim Group is not based on her own merits. Chrishell expressed her thoughts on the incident during a tense moment on the show, stating that even after showing the home to potential buyers and hosting open houses,
Nicole believed that Chrishell did not deserve credit when the property was sold.
The dispute caused further tension between the two women, with Chrishell expressing frustration over Nicole's bitterness and competitive behavior. It wasn't exclusive to real estate. The situation took a more personal turn when Chrishell made an accusation against Nicole for being under the influence of drugs during a group dinner.
The damage had already been done despite Nicole's denial of these allegations. The confrontation occurred before the cameras, and its aftermath contributed to their volatile relationship.

The Aftermath of the Confrontation

When Nicole reportedly brought up rumors about Emma Hernan allegedly sleeping with a married man, the situation between Nicole Young and Chrishell Stause came to a head. Emma, who denied these allegations, showed signs of being upset by the drama revealed during the confessional interview. The revelation caused more tension among the cast and caused many to wonder how the ongoing feud would play out on the show. Nicole and Chrishell attempted to resolve their issues in Season 7 but could not reconcile their differences. Nicole's refusal to apologize for her actions irreparably damaged their relationship. “At the end of the day, obviously I have very strong feelings about her that I stand 10 toes down on and I don’t take any of that back. I believe every bit of it,” said Stause. “However, I am also a business woman.I always will be able to change my mind if you add a zero. So listen, I hate her, but if you are going to pay me a ton of money to go say it to her face, then write the check.” In September 2024, Chrishell declared that Nicole would never be forgiven. In an interview with Extra, Chrishell discussed the situation, stating, "I will never work on a show with her again. Either she goes, or I go," she said firmly.
"Why are we giving her airtime? The audience doesn’t want to see this. She’s just hungry for camera time and lies to stay afloat and relevant on the show. There’s enough authentic drama in our lives—real-life issues, family struggles, and high-stakes luxury real estate deals. That’s what people want to see, not someone systematically plotting to take others down."

The Impact of the Feud on Selling Sunset

The Selling Sunset production was affected by tensions as Nicole and Chrishell's drama escalated. As reported, the production felt it was necessary to pause filming to prevent further conflicts on set due to Nicole's altercations with Chrishell and other cast members. Following an explosive incident at a cast dinner, Nicole's filming schedule was put on hold due to a confrontation between Nicole, Chrishell, and Emma Hernan. Nicole was frustrated and unsure about her decision to continue filming in such an unpleasant environment. She told Us Weekly, "I’m still debating whether or not I want to continue filming in this kind of environment, especially with so many infuriating double standards.” “Selling Sunset has been a great opportunity and a wild ride, but it is not my life or identity,” she explained. “I have a big, beautiful life outside of the show…and thankfully in the real world, my life and personality can’t be edited or misconstrued to portray me negatively to fit into a produced storyline.”

The Larger Impact on the Cast and the Show

The ongoing feud between Nicole Young and Chrishell Stause has undoubtedly affected the dynamics of the Selling Sunset cast. The controversy surrounding Nicole's involvement in spreading rumors and accusations and her drama has questioned the ethics of the show's production. Cast members like Emma Hernan have expressed dissatisfaction with how their personal lives were depicted, sparking a broader discussion about the ethical boundaries of reality television. "Since I wasn’t even given the chance to address these LIES on screen, I am taking matters into my own hands by sharing the truth,” Emma shared in an Instagram post. “Please swipe to see the receipts showing February 14th. While filming, Nicole was told clear as day ‘there was no affair,’ and she chose to film an entire season spreading lies.” Nicole has faced a difficult decision: whether to continue with Selling Sunset or quit a show that has caused her so much emotional turmoil.

Conclusion: The Future of Nicole Young on Selling Sunset

Nicole Young's status on Selling Sunset is still uncertain. Despite Netflix not confirming her return for future seasons, the tension and drama that surrounds her relationship with Chrishell Stause and the rest of the cast is still attracting fans and sparking conversations on social media. Nicole's participation in the show has caused controversy and intrigue as she considers her options.   The question remains: will Nicole continue with Selling Sunset or will she leave behind the drama and focus on her life outside the series? Selling Sunset is constantly changing, and the feud between Nicole and Chrishell will likely continue to play a significant role in the upcoming episodes. Fans of the show will inevitably be closely watching to see how this intricate situation unfolds.
